# FeatureFusion

> .NET engineering lab that extracts focused MIT BuildingBlocks (Mediator, Idempotency, keyset pagination, MCP, OpenTelemetry, Aspire SigNoz). The application is the laboratory; NuGet is the reusable result.

## Canonical

- [README](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/README.md): lab + package overview
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repo map for coding agents
- [Medium](https://medium.com/@m2hweb86/featurefusion-an-engineering-lab-that-extracts-reusable-net-building-blocks-28152cafafb9): lab-to-package narrative
- [Writing catalog](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/docs/linkedin-posts.md): LinkedIn / Medium post ↔ code map
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/Maxofpower/FeatureFusion/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
